chars.KHALID: KHALID: a young Moroccan man, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.KHADIJA: KHADIJA: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s, long wavy auburn hair, big gold hoop earrings, wearing a red satin blouse and black trousers
chars.ANAS: ANAS: a tall Moroccan man in his early 30s, slicked-back hair, wearing a crisp white linen shirt, beige chinos, a silver watch, sunglasses pushed up on his head
chars.SON: SON: a little Moroccan boy about 5 years old, curly brown hair, wearing a green t-shirt with a dinosaur on it

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, open door of a Casablanca apartment: KHALID stands in the doorway angrily pointing inside, KHADIJA blocks the door with her arm, arguing back with a defiant face; behind her the little SON peeks out sadly, and in the living room behind them loud party lights, bottles on a table and blurred young women dancing. Strong tension between the two adults.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daytime in front of a Moroccan courthouse with arches and a Moroccan flag in Casablanca: KHALID walks down the steps holding papers, frustrated, hand on his forehead.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a messy apartment living room: the little SON sits alone on the sofa hugging his knees, sad, while in the blurred background adults party with colored lights and bottles on the table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Afternoon at a Moroccan street cafe terrace in Casablanca with mint tea glasses: KHALID leans forward telling his story seriously, ANAS, just back from Germany, listens closely with a suitcase next to him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Evening on a Casablanca apartment balcony: KHADIJA leans on the railing, dreamy, gazing at the sea and the city lights, imagining a far away European life, a faint dream bubble of a European street with old buildings above her.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe terrace at dusk: KHALID leans in and whispers a secret plan into ANAS's ear with a sly smile, ANAS raises his eyebrows, surprised, then grins.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Sunny Casablanca street by the corniche: ANAS leans confidently against a shiny black luxury car, smiling charmingly, while KHADIJA walks past and looks back at him, clearly attracted, biting her lip.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night at a fancy restaurant table with candles: ANAS sits back, cold, shaking his head no, while KHADIJA across the table is shocked, her hands frozen in the air, her dream falling apart.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Daytime at the door of a modest apartment: KHALID opens the door calmly with his arms crossed, and KHADIJA stands outside, tired and defeated, holding the little SON's hand, about to ask him something. Tense silence between them.
